name: Conformance: Replay Effect Unreached
description: A long delay guards the side-effecting node, so a run cancelled mid-delay reaches terminal `cancelled` with NO recorded outcome for `effect`. RFC 0140: replaying that source run reaches a side-effecting node the source never recorded, which MUST fail closed with `replay_source_missing` and MUST NOT fire the effect. Spec: replay.md §"Side-effect suppression in replay" rule 3.

variables.name: delayMs
variables.description: Sleep duration (1..60000 ms). The conformance test sets this long enough to issue :cancel before the delay elapses, so `effect` is never reached in the source run.
